name: Split hero with trust badge, overlapping stat card, and plank texture accent
notes: Stat card (years in business / review count / rating) overlaps the hero image corner rather than living in its own section — keeps proof visible without adding vertical scroll. data-count-to attributes are hooks for a count-up-on-scroll script (not included, degrades to static numbers). No webfont dependency — deliberately system-font for a fast, plain-spoken feel matching the trade.
